div.div: Each non-host member gets one payment row. The amount is their total share including proportional VAT/service charge. Status tracks the payment lifecycle. The slip* columns store transfer slip verification data — when a friend uploads a bank slip, we extract the QR code and verify it against Bank of Thailand records.

div.div: When a friend opens the bill page and allows notifications, the browser gives us an endpoint URL + encryption keys. We store one subscription per member per room. p256dh and auth are Web Push encryption keys — required by the VAPID protocol to send encrypted push notifications without Firebase
